name: Indirect Graph Topology Certification
description: Instead of explicitly stating that m = n - 1 and that there is exactly one path between any two nodes (which models use as a direct trigger to use tree algorithms), the problem describes the graph as being fully connected but with the absolute minimum number of edges required to achieve that connectivity. This preserves the exact tree structure and mathematically implies m = n - 1, but forces the model to deduce the topology rather than matching the explicit tree keywords.
